en: Black‑and‑white aerial or elevated view of a central European small town square bordered by two‑storey historic buildings with sloped tiled roofs. The nearly empty square has a few trees aligned along the facades and a couple of lamp posts or monuments in the middle. Beyond the town stretch open fields and low hills, with an industrial chimney visible in the far distance. The card is framed by a white border typical of early 20th‑century postcards. No printed caption or handwriting is visible.
